concepts.title: Aperture K
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: single logo concept exploration for a crypto KOL and wallet tracking / lens intelligence product.
Text (verbatim): "kollns" — spelled k o l l n s, entirely lowercase.
Primary request: Design a distinctive minimal optical aperture built from three broad, smoothly curved geometric blades. The central negative space subtly evokes a K and a focused lens. The silhouette must remain strong at 24 px, with elegant fintech character.
Style/medium: flat, crisp vector-like logo art with even optical weight and generous negative space.
Color palette: one flat gold #F9C932 symbol, offwhite lowercase wordmark, near-black charcoal #101113 background.
Composition/framing: square image. A single symbol centered at upper-mid, around 34% of canvas width. The "kollns" wordmark centered beneath, around 39% of canvas width, in a refined bold geometric sans serif with generous gap and margins.
Constraints: one clean logo only. Plain background. No extra labels, slogan, mockup, panels or collage. No gradients, glow, shadows, texture, 3D, coin, Bitcoin sign, tiny circuitry, charts or people. Avoid camera-shop styling.

concepts.title: Signal Eye
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: new brand logo concept for a crypto KOL and wallet-tracking intelligence product.
Brand name (render exactly, verbatim): "kollns" — lowercase k o l l n s, six letters.
Create ONE clean square logo presentation. On a plain near-black charcoal #101113 background, show a centered compact flat gold #F9C932 abstract signal-eye symbol at upper-mid, with an offwhite lowercase "kollns" wordmark centered beneath it.
Symbol direction: an abstract compact eye formed by two broad open arcs enclosing one smaller off-center ring. Integrate a tiny deliberate opening in the ring and outer arcs to suggest detecting an onchain signal. The eye should feel asymmetric and dynamic, elegant and memorable, with broad simple forms and a silhouette that remains strong at 24 pixels. Avoid literal surveillance, Egyptian eye, camera, or anatomical eye illustration.
Typography: refined bold geometric sans serif, sophisticated contemporary technology brand, exact lowercase "kollns". Symbol approximately 34% of the canvas width; wordmark approximately 39% of canvas width. Generous gap between icon and wordmark, generous outer margins, balanced optical weight and generous negative space.
Style: crisp vector-like edges, entirely flat solid colors.
Constraints: one logo only. No extra labels, slogan, mockups, panels, collage, gradients, glow, shadows, texture, 3D, coins, Bitcoin signs, tiny circuitry, charts, people, watermarks.

concepts.title: Linked Lenses
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one new brand logo exploration for a crypto KOL and wallet tracking / lens intelligence product.
Primary request: an original compact mark for brand spelled exactly lowercase "kollns" (k o l l n s).
Direction: LINKED LENSES. Create a compact monogram-like symbol from two interlocking offset optical rings on a rising diagonal, sharing a clever negative-space lens at their overlap. The optical rings suggest connected influential wallets and looking through data. Broad clean strokes and a memorable asymmetrical silhouette. Ensure it is original, avoiding the silhouette of a generic chainlink/infinity/link icon, LinkedIn, or Mastercard.
Style/medium: extremely clean flat vector-like identity with crisp edges; a single solid flat gold #F9C932 symbol and offwhite wordmark.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly plain near-black charcoal #101113.
Composition/framing: square canvas. Icon centered at upper-mid, symbol about 34% of canvas width. Lowercase wordmark centered beneath it with generous vertical gap and margins, text width about 39% of canvas. Refined bold geometric sans serif type, optically balanced spacing and weight. Strong recognition at 24 px.
Text (verbatim): "kollns"
Constraints: one clean logo only, exactly those six lowercase letters k o l l n s. Balanced optical weight and generous negative space.
Avoid: extra labels, slogans, mockups, panels, collage, gradients, glow, shadows, texture, 3D, coins, Bitcoin signs, tiny circuitry, charts, people, trademark-like resemblance.

concepts.title: Radar Trail
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: single logo concept exploration for a crypto KOL and wallet tracking / lens intelligence product.
Text (verbatim): "kollns" — spelled k o l l n s, entirely lowercase.
Primary request: Create an original minimal circular tracking emblem. One broad open circular stroke spirals inward through a neat angled turn, finishing at a small solid signal node offset from center. It is one continuous route suggesting wallet movement being followed through a lens. Form a memorable compact emblem with smooth broad geometry and deliberate open negative space, dynamic but calm, readable at 24px.
Style/medium: perfectly flat color logo art with crisp vector-like edges and even weight.
Color palette: one flat gold #F9C932 symbol, offwhite lowercase wordmark, solid near-black charcoal #101113 background.
Composition/framing: square image. Single symbol centered at upper-mid at around 34% canvas width. "kollns" wordmark centered beneath at around 39% canvas width, in a refined bold geometric sans serif with generous vertical gap and margins.
Constraints: one clean logo only. No map pin, bullseye, fingerprint, magnifying glass, literal crosshair or generic power-button. No extra wording, collage, mockups, panels, texture, shadows, gradients, glow, 3D, coin, Bitcoin signs, charts or people.
